name: Macaroni, Italian Style
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ¼ cup finely chopped cold boiled ham

steps: Break macaroni in one-inch pieces and cook in boiling salted water, drain, and reheat in sauce made of butter, flour, and milk, to which is added cheese.
As soon as cheese is melted, season with salt and paprika, and turn on to a serving dish.
Sprinkle with ham, and garnish with parsley.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
